reason: A web client UI plugin that provides an interactive lightbox for enlarging, panning, and viewing markdown images.

summaries.zh: 为聊天中的 Markdown 图片提供点击放大的灯箱查看器，支持缩放、拖拽平移、适应窗口和打开原图。
summaries.en: Adds a lightbox viewer for chat Markdown images with zooming, panning, fit-to-window, closing, and original-image opening controls.

capabilities: Adds a click-to-zoom lightbox for absolute HTTP(S) markdown images
Supports zooming, panning, fit-to-window, closing, and opening the original image in a new tab
Installs document-level click handling and removes its DOM, styles, and listeners on unload
